findings.text: Finished Servex rows show no stop time, and their Duration keeps growing (requirement 3). The reason: `Agents.js` sets `stopped_at` only on an explicit stop (line 542), never when a run finishes, so `row_view` measures to *now*. Evidence: shots/…/1920.png, rows 1–5.

Cost is not on every row (requirement 3). The CLI/VS Code rows have an empty Cost cell (shots/…/1920.png, the "monorepo" rows), and at 1200 the Cost column is off the right edge of the grid entirely (shots/…/1200.png, the header ends at RAM).
